fill_kinds: flat RRGGBB or bilinear mesh *W H; no linear gradients in the live data

mesh_density.rule: flat if area < ~10 u2; 2x2 mesh if area < ~100 u2; otherwise cells of ~4 u (about 80%) or ~8 u for smooth soft-gradient shapes (about 20%): nx = round(bw/c)+1, ny = round(bh/c)+1 (bw, bh = tight bounds grown by 1 u). Verified against the percentiles above.

scale_rule.source: HomeSceneView: GeometryReader(.ignoresSafeArea) -> ForestPathIllustration().frame(geo.size).clipped() -> Canvas -> ForestPathArt.image(of:size:scale: displayScale) -> fillTransform(for: size)
scale_rule.raster: pixels = design * s * displayScale + (tx, ty) * displayScale; CPU coverage via CGContext, composited in ShapeRaster

code_changes: 2026-10-17: `private` dropped on ShapeDataReader and ShapeRaster (approved) so ForestPathExtension.swift reuses the parser and rasteriser; data section unchanged (data_sha256).
